trigger: Frostbite in Braith's right hand. Ames (if power_priority=hospital, he's ready).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Your right hand. Two fingers white and hard since the last cold night. You can't feel a wrench.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Mechanic. Your hands are your whole life. Let me see.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: You gave me power when no one else did. Warm water bath, the good drugs, a heated room. You keep the fingers.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: No heat, no warm bath, no time. I can save the hand. Maybe not both fingers.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You lose the tip of your ring finger. You'll learn to hold a torque wrench a new way.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: ...Fine. Priority. I hate that this works. Lie down.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Keep the hand warm. I need that hand. Everyone does.
